document: A first build of the marathon edition directory (proposal; decision D5 of the adoption plan). Not a published data file yet.

schema.city: the label of the edition’s race in the race registry: the pipeline’s `city`, the join key with year in every pack and data file
schema.race_id: the race in `races` (analysis/race-registry.json): its id (the label’s slug), display name, place and flags
schema.race: the race name written for the edition: the registry’s display name, or under a plain key the race name the release gives it
schema.release_city: the release’s own race key of the edition; never shown as a name
schema.tier: verification tier: stamped, stamped_weaker_source, partial, held_for_review or unverified
schema.verified_badge: true only on the two stamped tiers
schema.weaker_source: true when the stamp rests on a count likely built from the same timer file; the label must stay visible
schema.split_tier: splits, or finish_time_only when under half the rows have any intermediate split
schema.official_finishers: the independent official count the producer checked against, or null
schema.official_source_type: the producer’s description of that count’s source
schema.coverage_pct: the release’s rows with a finish time as a percentage of the official count (two decimals), or null
schema.hold_note: the producer’s hold note (on 20 editions, none of them held_for_review)
schema.timing_basis: the producer’s timing basis for the edition (chip, gun, mixed, unknown, or a platform’s own wording); it changes inside some series
schema.race_date: the race date used for ordering: the weather row’s, else a reviewed and cited date; null otherwise (the edition is then ordered by year only)
schema.producer_note_date: the one date=YYYY-MM-DD the producer’s completeness note states, unreviewed and never used as the race date
schema.rows: rows written to the adapted input (after the row rule)
schema.rows_in_release: marathon rows of the edition in the release
schema.rows_left_out: rows the adapter’s row rule leaves out
schema.finishes: written rows with a finish time
schema.timing_eligible: written rows that pass the timing checks: all nine checkpoints, increasing, finish 1:30 to 12:00, every section 2:00 to 20:00 per km
schema.counted: true when the edition supplies pooled pacing statistics under the frozen edition policy
schema.own_record: true when the edition is not counted but a record of it keeps an own-record view (unverified, or partial outside the coverage band, with a grid that passes the screens)
schema.not_counted_category: the policy’s category when it is not counted
schema.reason: index into `reasons`: the reason a visitor can read
